code:
-- Block-for-block identical copy
RMAN> DUPLICATE TARGET DATABASE FOR STANDBY
      FROM ACTIVE DATABASE;

ALTER DATABASE RECOVER MANAGED STANDBY DATABASE
  USING CURRENT LOGFILE DISCONNECT FROM SESSION;

-- Redo Apply = continuous media recovery
-- Active Data Guard: read-only queries WHILE
-- apply keeps running
caption: Exact copy. Simplest, safest, the default choice.
